$comment: Warnings of the official HL7 FHIR validator that CI accepts. Each entry needs the exact message id and the reason why the warning does not indicate a defect. Unused entries fail CI, so the list never goes stale.

warnings.reason: Best-practice invariant: a resource should have a narrative. The converter writes data, not human-readable text; a generated narrative would only repeat the data, and the receiving system renders it as it needs.
Best-practice recommendation. The performer comes from OBX-16 (responsible observer), which the sample messages leave empty; the converter does not invent one.

Best-practice recommendation. The time comes from OBX-14, or from the time of its order (OBR-7, OBR-8); an observation of an ADT message without OBX-14 has none, and the converter does not invent one.
